lede: Thirty-two small agents that check a nonprofit's back office from the files it already exports, gifts and deposits, donor letters, restricted funds, grants, events, memberships, endowments and year-end data, and wait for a named person before anything is paid, sent, filed or changed.
packages: Gifts against bank deposits and the ledger, acknowledgement letters, duplicate donor records (3 agents)
Year-end giving statements, gifts against deposits, acknowledgements, duplicate records, recurring gifts, vendor 1099 readiness (6 agents)
Deposits, letters, duplicates, recurring gifts, lapsed donors, gift coding, matching gifts, DAF grants, refunds, processor fees (10 agents)
Quid pro quo disclosures, event revenue split, in-kind gifts, memberships, giving statements, volunteer hours (6 agents)
Budget against actual with shared costs, indirect cost base and rates, reporting calendar, drawdowns, single audit threshold, payroll against effort (6 agents)
Fund balances by restriction, releases, board-designated funds, endowment draw, liquidity, pledges receivable (6 agents)
Functional expenses, expense reports, vendor 1099 readiness, Form 990 schedule data (4 agents)
All 32 agents, mapped to your exports and set to your policies, one training session
For accounting firms, fiscal sponsors and networks serving many nonprofits: all 32 agents, one shared setup, each client's exports mapped
support: Support after setup: $150 a month for one pack, $350 a month for the whole organization, $90 a month per client organization in a partner rollout. Includes export changes, threshold and rate updates, and a monthly check-in.
notes: Reads the files you export; it does not log in to your donor CRM, giving platform, payment processor, bank, payroll or accounting system.

Thresholds and rates (acknowledgement and quid pro quo figures, single audit threshold, de minimis rate, 1099 threshold, spending policy) are settings your accountant or auditor confirms; the defaults are examples.

Column layouts for Raiser's Edge NXT, Salesforce NPSP, Bloomerang, DonorPerfect, Little Green Light, Neon, Givebutter, Classy, PayPal, Stripe, QuickBooks Online, Aplos, Sage Intacct and Financial Edge NXT were written from knowledge of those systems; the first setup confirms them on your files.
It prepares data for Form 990, 1099s and grant reports; it files nothing and gives no tax or legal advice.
Report pages can be read in nine languages; those translations are Claude's and have not been reviewed by native speakers.
warn: Your files, reports and drafts stay on your computer. Donor, member, volunteer, staff and vendor names, e-mails, phones, addresses and taxpayer ids are masked in what is sent to an AI model; a name typed into a memo or note is sent as written unless it is also in a name column. The agents never pay, refund, charge a card, move money, post to the books, change the CRM, file with the IRS, a state or a funder, or send a letter; those wait for one named person or are refused.
groups: Gifts in the CRM matched to bank deposits and to contribution revenue in the ledger, by batch, date and amount
Gifts over your threshold with no letter, late letters, wrong amounts, no goods-or-services statement, letters for refunded gifts
Records that share an e-mail, phone, address or a name a letter or two apart, grouped for a person to merge
Failed and missed monthly gifts, cards about to expire, charges after a cancellation
Donors who gave last year or earlier and not this year, and retention by fiscal year
Notes that name a restricted purpose on the wrong fund, inactive funds, appeals coded away from their fund
Gifts from donors whose employer matches, with the amount and the claim deadline
DAF grants credited to the advisor, used for event benefits or applied to a personal pledge
Refunds still standing as gifts in the CRM, letters for refunded gifts, dispute evidence deadlines
Stripe, PayPal, Givebutter and Classy fees against your rate, gifts booked net, payouts missing from the bank
Payments over the threshold where the donor received something and the receipt has no disclosure or the wrong deductible amount
Tickets split into the exchange part and the contribution part, against your ledger
Gifts with no value or method, values from the donor only, appraisal thresholds, services to decide on
Memberships expiring or lapsed, dues that do not match the level, renewals that did not extend
Year-end contribution statements per giver, with refunds, undated gifts and loose offering set apart
Hours by program and their value, long or duplicate entries, background checks due
Budget against actual by grant and line, with shared costs split across several grants
The modified total direct cost base rebuilt per grant and the rate applied, against the indirect charged
Every report period from each grant's schedule, overdue and due-soon reports, a calendar file
What can be drawn, costs carried too long, draws ahead of costs or over the award
Federal spending by assistance listing number against the threshold in your settings
Salary charged to programs and grants against timesheets and effort certifications
Balances by restriction class, restricted funds below zero, endowments below corpus, interfund gaps
Spending and ended time restrictions not yet released, releases in error, a draft entry
Designations and spending against the board's resolutions
Each fund's draw from your spending policy, underwater funds, booked draws that differ
Financial assets available within one year and the months of expenses they cover
Aging, overdue installments, overpaid pledges, write-offs with no approver, multi-year pledges
Every expense given a function (program, management, fundraising) and the natural-by-function table
Missing receipts, meals over per diem, mileage over the rate, unallowable costs on grants, duplicate claims
Vendors paid over the threshold with no W-9, no or malformed taxpayer id, attorneys paid as corporations
Schedule B contributors with addresses, noncash totals, officer hours and pay, grants paid with EINs
closing: Each one does one job, on your computer, from a file you export. Nothing is paid, sent, filed or changed until a person you name says so.
